# Positive control for scripts/cpuid-clobber-check.ps1.
#
# A verbatim window from llvm-objdump of the kernel binary as it shipped
# BEFORE the 26 September 2026 CPUID fix. The 'movl %ebx, %ebx' at the
# second site is the bug: the register allocator chose rbx for the output,
# so the copy is a no-op and the following 'popq %rbx' discards the result.
#
# Kept because the bug cannot be reproduced by rebuilding the broken source:
# a rebuild on 27 September allocated r10d/r11d instead and came out correct.
# The only reliable positive control is the artifact that actually had it.
#
# Expected: scripts\cpuid-clobber-check.ps1 -Disassembly <this file> exits 1.

  106ac1:      	pushq	%r14
  106ac3:      	pushq	%rbx
  106ac4:      	xorl	%eax, %eax
  106ac6:      	xorl	%ecx, %ecx
  106ac8:      	pushq	%rbx
  106ac9:      	cpuid
  106acb:      	movl	%ebx, %esi
  106acd:      	popq	%rbx
  106ace:      	movl	%eax, %edi

  106ad5:      	xorl	%ecx, %ecx
  106ad7:      	pushq	%rbx
  106ad8:      	cpuid

  106adc:      	popq	%rbx
  106add:      	testl	%edi, %edi
